en: Vintage real-photo postcard showing a long, low hall-like building with a metal roof and several small roof vents. A line of young trees and a footpath run along the facade; a grassy field with a few people is in the foreground. A slender church spire is visible behind trees at the left, and low mountains/hills form the background. Overhead power lines cross the scene. The reverse has a divided back with penciled notes and a small serial number.
